summary: Centurion Acquisition Corp., a SPAC, filed an 8-K regarding Non-Redemption Agreements with certain shareholders to prevent redemption of 4,675,000 Class A ordinary shares at the upcoming EGM on the Extension Amendment Proposal, which would extend the business combination deadline from June 12, 2026 to June 12, 2027. In exchange, the Sponsor will transfer 1,558,333 Class A shares to these investors post-business combination. This is a SPAC extension inducement arrangement, not a definitive business combination. The filing details mechanics to secure the extension vote and reduce redemptions. Watch for the EGM outcome and any eventual de-SPAC announcement.
